     X1-missing + X2-missing groups; non-nesting ⇒ non-monotone; joint MLE has no
     closed form). Cox-Snell: b_s = ½ I^{rs}I^{tu}(K_{rtu} + 2 J_{t,ru}); extract Σ-block.

  - The non-monotone observed-data likelihood does NOT factor — monotone closed forms

  - Fallbacks if the algebra blows up: semi-symbolic b_Σ (symbolic in Σ at fixed μ),
